landing.heroDesc: A complete platform for clinics — manage patients, schedule visits, and track vaccinations. Plus a dedicated app for your clients.
landing.patientRecordsDesc: Breed, weight, allergies, complete medical history — digital profiles for every animal in your care. Always accessible, always current.
landing.schedulingDesc: Manage bookings, send automated reminders, and let clients schedule online. Your clinic's time, simplified.
landing.vaccinationDesc: Automated vaccination schedules with compliance tracking and timely alerts. No patient falls through the cracks.
landing.clientAppDesc: Pet owners get their own app to view records, book appointments, and receive vaccine reminders — synced with your clinic in real time.
landing.ctaDesc: Join veterinary clinics using VetApp to deliver better care and keep clients connected.
